executive_summary.finding: Monitoring overhead is the biggest HW risk: frontend periodic timers + backend process/GPU scans wake CPU unnecessarily.
Latency measurement is methodologically mixed (live/probe/proxy), which can pollute ranking for live dialog use.
Benchmark orchestration is robust via subprocess isolation, but file polling still adds overhead and state complexity.
Reproducibility is strong: deterministic selection, manifests, timeline events, immutable summary, host telemetry.
UTF-8/Unicode handling is mostly correct in core flows; major issues are architecture and measurement discipline.
Documentation drift exists (e.g., run_benchmark.py reference, .runtime vs runtime mismatch).
Validation signal is partially blocked by environment filesystem tempfile permission errors.

prioritized_weaknesses.problem: Monitoring consumes more HW than needed.
prioritized_weaknesses.root_cause: Split monitoring model without central budget.
prioritized_weaknesses.impact: Higher CPU and jitter during STT measurement.

prioritized_weaknesses.root_cause: File IPC instead of event streaming.

prioritized_weaknesses.impact: Slower refactor and higher regression risk.

prioritized_weaknesses.problem: Tests skewed toward smoke/schema over stress behavior.

first_fixes.change: Single monitoring budget: backend collector + frontend render-only.
first_fixes.benefit: Immediate CPU reduction and cleaner benchmark signal.

first_fixes.change: Split benchmark modes into strict_live vs batch_proxy in data model and scoring.
first_fixes.benefit: Methodologically clean comparisons for live scenarios.

first_fixes.change: Replace file polling with append-only event store (SQLite WAL or lightweight bus).
first_fixes.benefit: Lower I/O overhead and better traceability.

quick_wins: Switch /api/health/processes default from full to fast.
Add TTL cache for cmdline/exe per PID in health scan.
Throttle progress writes to state changes or coarse buckets.
Unify dashboard RAM/CPU sampling from one batch timer.
Align docs on runtime path naming and remove invalid run_benchmark.py references.
defer_now: Model/adaptor expansion before strict live-vs-proxy methodology is enforced.
UI cosmetics before metric correctness and monitoring overhead are fixed.
Mobile platforms before stable benchmark harness for scenarios 1-4.

target_architecture.flow: Worker events -> Event store -> Aggregator -> API/WebSocket -> Frontend render

phased_plan.scope: Monitoring budget + default fast scan + docs drift fixes
Strict latency mode split + score gating by quality class

uncertainties: Environment-level tempfile permission errors reduce local behavior-test confidence.
No full on-target HW runtime profiling executed in this audit step.
GPU metric fidelity depends on nvidia-smi and host GPU stack.
top_3_root_causes: Mixed measurement modes in one decision lane.
File-polling orchestration instead of event-native runtime.
top_3_highest_roi_interventions: Hard split of strict_live and batch_proxy in data and scoring.
Append-only event store (SQLite WAL) for job/tuning telemetry.
top_3_risks_if_unchanged: Wrong best-model selection for live Czech due to metric distortion.
Growing coupling slows delivery and increases regressions.
